name: Gwythyr fab Greidawl

attributes.attribute: He was one of two suitors for Creiddylad, the maiden of springtime.
In Beltane ceremonies he represented summer.
He always won, defeating the winter king Gwynn ap Nudd.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gwythyr fab Greidawl was a Welsh folkloric warrior. He was one of two suitors for Creiddylad, the maiden of springtime, in ceremonies that marked Beltane. Representing summer, Gwythyr always won and defeated the winter king, Gwynn ap Nudd.

okr.objective: Present Gwythyr fab Greidawl as the summer warrior who won Creiddylad against the winter king at Beltane.
